summary: Tested Phase 05 Search & Discovery and weekly Restock Reminders end to end, through the API and the UI (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Backend: the full suite has 69 tests and they pass 3 out of 3 runs: the 64 existing tests plus 5 new ones in test_phase05_extended.py. The new tests cover: facets scoped to the selected category; pending, rejected and draft products and unpublished stores hidden from search, suggestions and facets; regex and special-character queries; inclusive price bounds; Sec-GPC; and purge permissions. The re-check of category-scoped facets passed: vendor, price and in-stock facets follow the category filter, while category counts stay unscoped. UI with live seeded data: /shop shows 'Showing 24 of 34', Load more brings it to 34 of 34 and sets ?page=2, and reloading restores it. Vendor, category, price and in-stock filters combine correctly. Back and forward buttons work. Filter chips can be removed, and Clear all works. The 'Best match' sort appears only when q is present. Relevance order and price-desc order are correct. Partial match ('bask' finds Bolga Market Basket) works. Draft products are never shown. Error states work: min>max shows 'Minimum price is higher than maximum price.' and category=nope shows 'Category not found.' The empty state works. Category page: the Subcategories filter (All Fashion 2 / Dresses 1) works, vendor facets show only that category's vendors, and in_stock persists after reload. Search suggestions work in both the header dialog and on the /search input: keywords, products, categories and vendors appear; 1 character gives no suggestions; drafts are excluded; clicking a suggestion navigates and pressing Enter submits. Dev-data mode (no live products) works on the same layout. Vendor 'Low-stock emails' select: choosing weekly shows a toast and the choice persists after reload. Cron endpoint: no auth returns 401, a valid call returns 202 accepted, the same X-Webhook-Id returns duplicate, and a missing run id returns 400. The run finished with status done and result {sent:0, failed:1} because email returned 429 (expected). Admin /admin/search-insights: totals, top and no-result lists, privacy note, days selector and purge (cancel and confirm, then 0 records) all work. Non-admins are redirected to /forbidden. No horizontal overflow at 390px on any page tested. One test isolation flake was found and fixed in the test file (details below). Only minor issues remain.

minor.issue: Each page-1 search visit is logged twice in the preview. React.StrictMode runs effects twice, which sends two /catalog/search requests. Back/forward or remounting the page also logs the search again. As a result, one user's single search reaches the k=2 privacy threshold and appears in 'Searches with no results' (seen with 'zzzz' and 'hidden draft', each searched once and shown as '2 searches'). Production builds don't run effects twice, but remounts still log again. Suggestion: dedupe on the client, for example send a log=0 parameter on refetches, or log only on explicit submit or navigation.
Any MODERATOR role can delete all search analytics. Consider limiting this to marketplace or super admins. The action is audited.
Sorts by price_min_minor. A product with several variants is ranked by its cheapest variant, not its most expensive one.

Vendor, price and in-stock facet counts ignore the active vendor, price and in-stock filters; only the category filter scopes them. This appears to be by design. Example: with a $20–60 filter showing 2 results, the sidebar still shows 'In stock only 33' and 'Prices here: $10–$90'.

ui_bugs.issue: load() has no try/catch. If the API fails, the page stays blank and the promise rejection is unhandled. No loading or error state.
The count adds min and max separately: 'Filters (5)' appears while there are 4 chips (category, vendor, price, in-stock).

integration_issues.issue: localSearch never errors. /search?min=50&max=10 and /search?category=nope show the empty state instead of search-error. localSuggest matches substrings in the middle of words: 'ke' suggests 'Market Spice Sampler' and 'Woven Wall Basket Set', while the API matches word prefixes only.

Stale requests are not cancelled or ignored. If filters change quickly, a slower earlier response can overwrite newer results. Also, an error during Load more replaces the whole results grid with the error box.

issues: The sheet stays open after a filter is picked, so the user has to close it to see results. Acceptable, but consider showing a 'Show N results' button.

action_items: Stop duplicate search-analytics logging from StrictMode double effects and remounts (dedupe on the client or log only on explicit submit), so the k=2 privacy threshold is meaningful.
Add error and loading handling to AdminSearchInsightsPage.load.

Optional: ignore stale responses in useDiscovery (request id or AbortController); count price as one filter in activeCount; make localSearch/localSuggest match the API behaviour (validation errors, word-prefix matching).
Optional: restrict the search-analytics purge to marketplace/super admins; sort price-desc by price_max_minor.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog.py run_search: full-text search falls back to partial (word-prefix regex) matching only when no text match exists. The regex is escaped, so injection-style queries ('(.*', '$where', '[[') return 200.

Visibility is enforced in one place (visible_vendor_ids: active vendor AND published store, plus status=active) and used by search, suggest, facets, storefront and product detail. Verified against suspended vendors, unpublished stores, and draft, pending and rejected products.
The cron endpoint uses hmac.compare_digest, a run_id unique insert for idempotency, and background work with a 202 response. Good.

Test isolation: test_phase05_search.client() deleted ALL 'login:' rate_limits. Running in parallel, this made test_phase02_extended::test_lockout_cannot_be_bypassed_with_x_forwarded_for flaky (about 1 failure in 3 runs). Narrowed to '^register:'; the suite then passed 3 out of 3 runs.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase05_search.py (rate_limits cleanup narrowed to ^register: to fix the flaky lockout test)

success_rate.backend: 100% (69/69, stable over 3 runs after the isolation fix)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; minor issues only)

For UI with live data, run python -m tests.ui_seed_phase05 and log in as the vendor email in /tmp/p5seed.json. Every vendor store is named 'TEST Biz', so vendor names repeat. Browser searches are logged twice in the preview (StrictMode). Clean with the seed 'clean' command and delete search_queries and cron_runs test-* records.
